items.headline: Marty & McGee's must win matchups in Week 4

items.headline: Why the QB play has to improve for the Aggies and LSU?
items.description: As both teams have less than a 30% chance to make the CFP, SEC Now's Benjamin Watson and Chris Doering analyze what No. 23 Texas A&M and No. 10 LSU have to do to better their chances.

items.headline: SEC irked LSU is trying to dismiss suit with issue 'unresolved'
items.description: The SEC is "deeply disappointed" LSU tried to dismiss its lawsuit against the university stemming from an attempt to add former NFL players to the Tigers' roster.

items.headline: Week 4 boasts most ranked games since 2023 -- will the results match?
items.description: While the six ranked-on-ranked games we'll see this weekend is rare, it's not unprecedented. It last happened in 2023, producing a memorable slate.

items.headline: Connelly checks in on the SEC's launch party and Big Ten's question marks in Week 4
items.description: After teasing us with ranked games over three weeks, we get six that should tell us a lot about the 2026 season.
